crossDecoderReview.interpretation: Frame-count equality is not sample alignment. WAV PCM16 SFX must preserve frame count and every PCM value. Ogg music may retain a decoder offset and frame-count variance, but every CoreAudio-decoded boundary must independently satisfy the numeric seam gate.

pcm16DitherReview.method: reviewer reconstructs signed PCM16 from the encoded PCM24 master with the stable asset-ID seed and compares every sample value
